name: Quercetin
summary: Quercetin is a flavonoid investigated as a senolytic, with most human evidence coming from dasatinib+quercetin (D+Q) combination trials rather than quercetin alone. A 2026 trial in fibrotic MASH showed >=1-stage fibrosis improvement in 47% vs 7% placebo (PMID 42823536); a 2024 bone trial in postmenopausal women missed its primary resorption endpoint (PMID 38956196).
description: Canonical quercetin research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until the quercetin-alone vs D+Q combination boundary is explicit, senolytic dosing/safety is documented, and fisetin comparative evidence is adjudicated, passing the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: senescent cell clearance (combination); antioxidant activity; inflammatory signaling
